programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 20
programme.desc: Suki, Toph, and Sokka try to stop the Fire Lord's fleet before they hit land, while Azula prepares for her coronation day.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 21
programme.desc: Sokka and Toph manage to disable the airships while Zuko and Katara confront Azula. Aang finally faces off against the Fire Lord.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 1
programme.desc: Katara and Sokka, a brother and sister from the Southern Water Tribe, discover a twelve-year-old boy frozen in an iceberg. Katara wonders if this boy is the Avatar whom the world has been awaiting.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 2
programme.desc: Prince Zuko, a young Firebender whose mission in life is to capture the Avatar, tracks Aang down to the Southern Water Tribe village where Katara and Sokka live.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 3
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 4
programme.desc: When locals of a small island discover Aang is the Avatar, they treat him like a celebrity.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 5
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 6
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 7
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 8
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 9
programme.desc: When Katara's desire to master Waterbending gets the best of her, the kids find themselves on the run from pirates.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 10
programme.desc: Our heroes' friendship is tested when they meet Jet, a charismatic teenager leading a band of rebels who are fighting against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 11
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 12
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 13
programme.desc: When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 14
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives but they are so reliant that they are blind to the imminent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 15
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 16
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 17
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 18
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 19
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 20
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan. Aang goes to the spirit world for help.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 1
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful `Avatar State' as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But it's more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 2
programme.desc: On the way to Omashu, the kids meet some nomads who show them a shortcut through the `cave of two lovers'. When they get lost in the caves, they must trust in love to escape.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 3
programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi; however, when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 4
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being `connected to the Earth' from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 5
programme.desc: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates `Avatar Day'. They learn that it is not a celebration of the Avatar, but a festival of anger for something Aang did in his past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 6
programme.desc: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 7
programme.desc: Travelling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 8
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 9
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 10
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 11
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 12
programme.desc: When the kids can't take the easy way into Ba Sing Se, they must escort a family of refugees there the hard way, through the deadly Serpent's Pass.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 13
programme.desc: Aang discovers a colossal Fire Nation invention heading for Ba Sing Se, and the kids must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 14
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 15
programme.desc: A series of short stories that explore the individual adventures of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtle Trek
programme.desc: Krang activates his new dimensional portal, thanks to Shredder's installation of the Energy Transmitter at the Power Relay Station, giving him access to Dimension X.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Unknown Ninja
programme.desc: While watching video tapes of old battles, Raphael sees a mystery person spying on them. While the Turtles investigate, an alien warlord named Dregg sends his TechnoGansters to steal all the gold on Earth.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Dregg of the Earth
programme.desc: April contacts the Turtles to let them know that Dregg has landed on Earth and is preparing a press conference. The Turtles rush to meet April at the Park, where they hear Dregg announce his intentions and offers the world his molecular converter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Wrath of Medusa
programme.desc: Believing that the Turtles are the only thing that stands between him and total domination of the planet, Dregg makes contact with Medusa, a sinisterly beautiful alien.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Showdown
programme.desc: April contacts the Turtles to inform them that all the TV stations in the City are jammed. Sleazebug tries to recruit the Turtles for a martial arts tournament.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Split-Second
programme.desc: Carter, April and the Turtles investigate a break-in at the Antique Timepiece Museum. Convinced that Dregg is responsible, the Turtles discover a clue on a wall display.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Carter the Enforcer
programme.desc: Splinter convinces the Turtles that it is their duty to fight evil, even when the whole world is against them. Carter and the Turtles team up with April to get the goods on Dregg.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Return of Dregg
programme.desc: While the Turtles work on using fragments of the Vortex Crystal to stabilize their mutations, Lord Dregg plans to use the fragments to create another Vortex Crystal to power his Vortex Transporter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Beginning of the End
programme.desc: While Raphael, Michelangelo, Donatello and Carter work on restoring Leonardo to his regular self, Mung steals all the plutonium from a power plant in order for Dregg to build a Plutonium Ray to turn Leonardo into a radioactive killer.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Power of Three
programme.desc: Mungg informs Dregg that he came across two individuals who claimed they were old acquaintances of the turtles: Shredder and Krang!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): A Turtle in Time
programme.desc: The Turtles', Shredder's and Krang's battles skills, powers, and memories are absorbed into Dregg.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtles to the Second Power
programme.desc: Dregg and his crew plan an invasion of Earth to make it his new home base, but first he has to get his transporter chip back from Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Day the Earth Disappeared
programme.desc: With the city breaking apart, the Turtles head to the street to investigate and see the Dreggnaut appear in the sky. With Mung's help, Dregg reprograms the transporter to open a warp in space.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Divide and Conquer
programme.desc: Lord Dregg launches a final attack on the Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtle Tracks
programme.desc: April O'Neil, ace reporter for Channel 6, investigates recent break-ins, allegedly by Ninjas, which have resulted in the thefts of numerous technologies.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Enter: The Shredder
programme.desc: The Shredder kidnaps Splinter in an attempt to lure the Turtles to his own cause. In order to rescue Splinter the Turtles must enter the Shredder's mobile fortress and brave its dangerous weaponry.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): A Thing about Rats
programme.desc: Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist, is showing an exterminator his new invention: a rat catching robot called Mousers.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Hot Rodding Teenagers from Dimension X
programme.desc: Shredder experiments with the Inter-Dimensional Portal, hoping to contact Krang's' Rock Soldiers and prepare an invasion of Earth.
programme.sub-title: Hot Rodding Teenagers from Dimension X

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Shredder & Splintered
programme.desc: Shredder lures Splinter into the Technodrome, this time with the promise that a weapon in his possession can restore the sensei to human form.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Return of the Shredder
programme.desc: Shredder trains students at the Dojo for a crooked Turtles gang. The mock turtles' crime spree starts turning the public against Michelangelo, Raphael, Donatello and Leonardo.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Incredible Shrinking Turtles
programme.desc: In the first of a four-parter, the amazing amphibians search for the segments of the powerful crystal Eye of Sarnoth. Shredder cuts the Turtles down to size, literally.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): It Came from Beneath the Sewers
programme.desc: In the second of a four-parter about the pursuit of the Eye of Sarnoth, the Turtles are attacked by a huge alien plant that is making New York into a jungle.
programme.sub-title: It Came from Beneath the Sewers

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Mean Machines
programme.desc: The hunt for the Eye of Sarnoth continues in the third of a four-parter with the Turtles in Groucho-like disguises. Shredder hooks up a fragment of the Eye to the computer Omnus.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Curse of the Evil Eye
programme.desc: Shredder is in control of the Eye of Sarnoth, enabling him to transmute matter. Shredder brings to life a dragon which soars through the air with shocked shellbacks Leonardo and Michelangelo aboard.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Case of the Killer Pizzas
programme.desc: The Turtles' favourite food, pizza, is also the source of their problem. Nasty, fanged creatures have been planted in pizza boxes! When the critters crack open their chrysalises, they become enormous.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Enter: The Fly
programme.desc: Shredder sends April a rare duko plant that renders her unconscious. The Turtles seek a rare leaf that can serve as an antidote.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Invasion of the Punk Frogs
programme.desc: Mutagen, sent by Krang from Dimension X, changes four Florida frogs into half-human creatures four and a half feet tall. Shredder, training them in his evil ways, names them Attila the Frog, Genghis Frog, Rasputin the Mad Frog and Napoleon Bonafrog.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Splinter No More
programme.desc: Michelangelo senses that their mentor is "mondo depressed" and Donatello finds a way of changing back Splinter the rat to Yoshi the man.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): New York's Shiniest
programme.desc: Shredder taps into New York's computers to steal plans for robots and creates an army of robots to destroy the Turtles and loot the city.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Teenagers from Dimension X
programme.desc: Neutrino teens Kala, Zak and Eask arrive on Earth and alert the Turtles to Shredder's latest plan to make "mindless zombies" of the Turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Catwoman from Channel 6
programme.desc: A matter transporter results in strange happenings including TV reporter April O'Neil being put into a cat-like state and a tiger chasing the Turtles and Splinter, their mentor-rat.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Return of the Technodrome
programme.desc: To bring the Technodrome back to Earth, Shredder is instructed to take over the Niagara Falls hydroelectric station.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Beneath These Streets
programme.desc: While the Turtles, in disguise, are at a movie, Shredder interrupts a press conference to steal a new medi-laser.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Turtles on Trial
programme.desc: While the Turtles go on a talk show to prove their innocence to the world, Krang steals a robot and some Solarbenite from a military warehouse, with the intention of destroying the Turtles himself.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Attack of the 50-Foot Irma
programme.desc: While the Turtles are planning Irma's birthday party, Shredder steals an Exaboron Isotope from a meteorite crash. Krang creates an Exaboron-powered Enlarging Ray which causes six times normal growth, with the intention of using it on Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): The Maltese Hamster

programme.desc: Jonny enters the world of professional drifting as competes in the famous Gatebil show in Norway, driving a specially modified BMW M5. To give himself a fighting chance, he first arranges some tuition from the 2011 British Drift Champion Matt Carter.

programme.title: Fifth Gear: Episode 15
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson is joined by Norwegian rally prodigy Andreas Mikkelsen for a high octane motoring triathlon - racie in a 200bhp off road buggy, perform an autotest in a Skoda Fabia hot hatch, and battle wheel to wheel in single seat race cars.

programme.title: Fifth Gear: Episode 16
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Italy testing the most powerful Ferrari ever made, the brand new 730bhp F12berlinetta, to the limit. Tiff and Jason are at the track with the two cheapest hot hatches on sale – the Suzuki Swift and Renault Sport Twingo.

programme.title: Fifth Gear: Episode 17
programme.desc: Vicki goes behind the scenes of famous Italian car designers Pininfarina – the people who have shaped every single Ferrari of the last 50 years. Tiff is joined by British rally star Mark Higgins in a test of two new SUVs with supercar power figures

programme.title: Fifth Gear: Episode 18
programme.desc: Tiff is joined by German motoring legend and 'Queen of the Nurburgring' Sabine Schmitz for a head to head battle between our two favourite sports cars of the last year – the BMW M6 and Porsche 911.

programme.title: Fifth Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies

programme.title: Fifth Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell pit what could be the greatest drivers' car of the century – the Toyota GT86 – against its tough rival from Renault Sport. Jonny Smith is in Spain to put Jaguar's brand new F-Type through its paces

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Danny charges Ryan with customizing a new Chevy Silverado for their most difficult customer--himself! Danny wants it to maintain the flavor of his old '56 truck, but wants more comfort and reliability.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: The team is commissioned to build a bike for a military veteran. He wants to show his love for family and country by covering the bike with American flags and portraits of loved ones who also served.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: When Tommy Lee's beloved bike gets crushed in an accident, he turns to the only person he trusts to fix it--the guys who built it--Count's Kustoms.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Ryan, Mike and Shannon convince Danny to sponsor them in a 24-hour junk car endurance race. Meanwhile Danny has the guys work on a one of a kind special shop project as payback for his sponsorship.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: The guys finally find a not so perfect car for the junk car race which they resurrect as the "Count's Bloody Mess". At the race, they realize first place may not be an option, but hope that "Count's Bloody Mess" will finish in one piece.
programme.sub-title: The Fast and the Ridiculous, Part 2

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Twisted Sister's Dee Snider brings the crew a brand new BMW Z4 that he wants Count-ified for his wife Suzette as an anniversary present. A simple paint job turns disaster when Suzette is not happy with the final look, not once, but twice.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Kevin's brother Steve wants a 1980 Kawasaki KZ100 motorcycle tricked out just like the ones on the classic TV series, CHiPs.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Ryan and Kevin find a 1972 Datsun 240z that Danny agrees to flip. But when he has a last-minute change of heart, Ryan must figure out how to make Danny's vision a reality without derailing the project.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Danny is commissioned to custom paint a brand new pick-up for a charity auction for the local YMCA. But Danny can't stop at paint, he adds the ultimate accessory a matching chopper that fits in the back.

programme.title: Counting Cars
programme.desc: Danny and Shannon are in motorcycle heaven when they are asked to restore a rare 1957 Harley Davidson Pan head prototype that has spent the last 20 years in their client's living room.

programme.sub-title: I'm Sexy and I Know It

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: A hospital visit thaws tensions between Aaron and Talia. Holly goes shopping for bridesmaid dresses and Casey hatches a plan behind Marnie's back. (S3, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Aaron meets Talia to try and save their relationship. Holly goes on the hunt for her wedding dress and Casey is nearly ready to pop the question... there's just one thing missing. (S3, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly debates taking Jacob's name, Aaron and Talia have couples counselling and the time has come for Casey to propose to Marnie. Will he hold his nerve? (S3, ep5)
programme.sub-title: I Think I Wanna Marry You

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie's illness takes a dramatic turn for the worse, Aaron and Talia make a massive step in the right direction and Holly hits the hat shop with her mam. (S3, ep6)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie and Casey return to the scene of an old argument. Aaron hits the dirt bike track and Holly comes face to face with the past at her hen party. (S3, ep7)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: The OGs are back but will Aaron and Talia's relationship survive a new baby? Will Marnie and Casey stay strong after a recent split? Will Holly and Jacob ever get married? (S4, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie plans some big life goals. Holly finds her dream home, but will she get a mortgage? Sophie realises her friends are moving on but she isn't. Aaron goes all out for Talia's birthday. (S4, ep2)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Marnie and Casey view houses but do they want the same things? Holly pursues her PT qualifications while Aaron deals with his choking fears. Sophie embarks on an interesting journey. (S4, ep3)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Sophie visits Charlotte for advice, Holly visits Charlotte Dawson and gets fired up. Aaron and Talia visit her family. Marnie gets a visit from her wedding planner who brings bad news. (S4, ep4)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly goes ahead with her "warts an' all" Body Confidence photoshoot! Sophie reveals some truths to a life coach. Marnie and Casey have got wedding venue issues. It's Romeo's 1st Birthday! (S4, ep5)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly posts the Body Confidence photos and is noticed by a Kardashian! Aaron's eyeing his first boxing match and Marnie falls in love with a million-pound pad. (S4, ep6)

programme.title: Geordie OGs
programme.desc: Holly turns to the spiritual world for wedding answers. Marnie's million pound home offer is accepted and Talia's waters break prematurely, sparking dramatic events. (S4, ep7)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: The honeymoon period is over as Vicky and Ricci split. Rebecca reveals her secret party trick, much to Jay's delight, whilst Gary comes clean with Charlotte. It's pure mental like! (S2, ep7)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: It's almost the end of the gang's time in the house, and hardly any relationships are left intact. Vicky and Ricci move on, Sophie gets dumped and Jay leaves a bad taste in Rebecca's mouth. (S2, ep8)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: The Reunion brings the cast and their friends & families together to find out what really went down during series 2. Host Russell Kane will rummage through the tensions, passions, laughter and tears.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: It's time to swap the grey river Tyne for the crystal blue waters of Cancun, Mexico for the carnage of Spring break! Vicky and Ricci are loved up, whilst Jay is missing the love of his life. (S3, ep1)

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: With the house reduced to carnage and Sophie losing even more faith in boyfriend Joel, there are still plenty of beaches to party on. Meanwhile Holly ups her game in the pursuit of James. (S3, ep2)

programme.title: JAG: Impact
programme.desc: Harm and Bud investigate the crash of a Marine helicopter whose dead pilot is being blamed for the incident. They discover the chopper seems to have been hit by some form of UFO. Government security officials want to maintain a cover-up at all costs.

programme.title: JAG: People V. Rabb
programme.desc: Harm is arrested by the FBI for the murder of Konaplanik, a Russian who was selling Harm supposedly accurate information about his missing father's whereabouts. The killer turns out to be Col. Tomashevsky, a Russian agent.

programme.title: JAG: Defensless
programme.desc: A woman Navy ensign shoots and kills a Turkish colonel; she claims self-defense.

programme.title: JAG: With Intent to Die
programme.desc: With help from Harm, Mac, Harriet, and Bud, Admiral Chedwiggen investigates the apparent suicide of his mentor, Admiral Clancy, who allegedly shot himself while on a hunting trip. Harm and company ultimately uncover who the killer was.

programme.title: JAG: Father's Day
programme.desc: Mac and Harm are assigned the task of defending a young Marine whose frustration at being unable to wrest custody of his son has led to his being court-martialed for dereliction of duty.

programme.title: JAG: Tiger, Tiger
programme.desc: Harm takes Josh on a weekend cruise for Navy families aboard a frigate. When the frigate is taken over by terrorists who intend to fire missiles at Cuba, Harm and Bud take matters into their own hands to stop the evil plot.

programme.title: JAG: Return of Mimmy Blackhorse
programme.desc: An Army forensic pathologist joins forces with Harm, Mac, Bud and Harriet as they try to verify that newly unearthed human remains are those of a heroic Navajo "code-talker" who had been missing since WWII.

programme.title: JAG: The Imposter
programme.desc: Harm is held captive by Palmer, a renegade government agent with whom he had crossed swords a few months ago. While Palmer prepares a life mask so he can pass for Harm, he explains his plans to assassinate the key witness in the trial.

programme.title: JAG: To Russia With Love
programme.desc: With evidence that his missing father could still be alive in, Harm convinces the Admiral to give him time off so he can go to Russia. In Moscow, they are questioned by Mark Falcon, the KGB agent who had stolen a list of POW's earlier from Harm.

programme.title: JAG: Gypsy Eyes
programme.desc: Unable to lose the pursuing Russian fighters, Harm's and Mac’s hijacked Mig is shot out of the sky over Siberia.

programme.title: JAG: Act of Terror
programme.desc: When Arab terrorists attach a mine to a US Navy warship in an attempt to sink it, Marine guards are able to kill one and capture the other, even after the mine explodes, killing two sailors.

programme.title: JAG: The Black Jet
programme.desc: Harm and Mac are sent to Teheran, Iran to represent a Navy flier whose Stealth jet crashed in Iran due to a major mechanical failure.

programme.title: JAG: Silent Service
programme.desc: Mac and Harm are having trouble relating...a result of working together under stress for so long.

programme.title: JAG: King of the Greenie Board
programme.desc: Harm is now a Tomcat division commander aboard the carrier USS Patrick Henry that is patrolling the Mediterranean near Yugoslavia.

programme.title: JAG: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: The Russians are furious over the killing of their peacekeepers and the Navy sends Mac, Brumby, and Roberts to the Patrick Henry to conduct the court-martial of Lt. Buxton.

programme.title: JAG: True Calling
programme.desc: When a petty officer smuggles a pregnant Serbian woman aboard the carrier in order to save her from a vengeful fiancée, he's arrested and scheduled to be court-martialed.

programme.title: JAG: Psychic Warrior
programme.desc: When a Navy research project involving ESP and psychic phenomenon goes awry, resulting in the death of one of the research subjects, the Admiral in charge is court-martialed.

programme.title: JAG: Rouge
programme.desc: As the lowest ranking lawyer at JAG, Bud is assigned to accompany Raglan, a former Special Forces operative who is hired by the Pentagon to test security at military bases.

programme.title: JAG: Mishap
programme.desc: "Skates", Harm's RIO when he was aboard the USS Patrick Henry, was the Landing Safety Officer in charge of the deck when a Tomcat crashes while making an emergency landing.

programme.desc: A stolen Dodge Ram 1500 crashes and knocks the power out. A woman caught huffing canned air in a stolen car keeps changing her story. A FLIR-equipped helicopter is used to catch fleeing juveniles.

programme.desc: Audrey embarks on a new start after quitting her demanding job; however, her time at home makes her stir crazy, prompting her to start a cookie business. Timmy is getting advice from the guys who encourage him to be more of a dude than a gentleman.

programme.desc: Jeff and Audrey embark on finding a surrogate mother, only to run into problems with the interviewing process. Russell's wealthy mother comes to town, and he reluctantly decides to have her stop paying his rent.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Home Stretch

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Uh-Oh It's Magic
programme.desc: When Russell takes his date to a magic show, the magician makes her disappear. Meanwhile, Audrey unknowingly slips up when she tells Brenda's girlfriend about the baby.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Singing and Dancing

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: Zygote

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Set Up
programme.desc: When Russell discovers Timmy has a sister, he aims to impress her. Meanwhile, Jeff and Audrey set their neighbor Liz up on a date.

programme.desc: When Jeff and Audrey learn their surrogate is pregnant, both of their lives change. Meanwhile, Timmy takes on the responsibility of wedding planner for Adam and Jennifer.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement: The Jeff Photo

programme.desc: Jeff and Audrey panic when they are told they might be having twins. Meanwhile, Russell throws a citizenship party for Timmy to impress a girl.

programme.desc: Jeff celebrates Audrey's inability to talk after her node removal surgery. Russell gets Timmy to fire an employee for him, and Adam discovers he's only getting free stuff because of his good looks.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Bliss
programme.desc: Lili is given a psychotropic drug called "bliss" via a Taelon device. They discover it is widespread. With an instantly strong addictive property, the addicts are dying within 48 hours. The investigation leads Liam and Sandoval to Ireland.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Highjacked
programme.desc: With a reporter on board, the Taelon mother ship is highjacked into interdimensional space. Liam is the prime suspect, causing an even bigger rift between Da'an and Zo'or. As the ship floats, lost in space, they must find the real culprit.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Defector
programme.desc: A shuttle crashes on a beach after being pursued by a second Taelon piloted shuttle. When Liam locates the survivor (a Taelon called Belleye), he claims to want to help the Resistance take back Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Heroes and Heartbreak
programme.desc: Augur is recruited by a Taelon weapons project, but the others are worried about his involvement. When the project is launched earlier than originally planned to fight a Jiridian fleet, the Earth is in danger.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A Jiridian probe headed for Earth is shot down by the Taelon Embassy and crashes outside of D.C. Liam recovers the probe, but he, Augur, and Julia are captured by another underground resistance movement led by the real Colonel Liam Kincaid.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crossfire
programme.desc: As the election draws near, Liam believes Zo'or is trying to have Jonathan Doors murdered. The Resistance worries that an attack is imminent at the final debate. Julia mobilizes a group to protect Doors against Liam's wishes.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crackdown
programme.desc: An unknown woman saves Augur and Liam from the raids on the Resistance. Lili sabotages the mother ship, but Zo'or stops its total destruction. Lili is reportedly dead. The investigation on the President's shooter continues.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Vanished
programme.desc: Some who were detained during the Resistance sweep have not reappeared after their release. Lili is taken to a lab run by Sandoval and implanted. Renee tries to help Liam find the missing people.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Emancipation
programme.desc: A group posing as volunteers attacks using a stolen skrill prototype that does not require an implant to control. It is discovered that the skrill queen is also missing. The investigation leads to a resistance group called Black Wednesday.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: A joint Doors International/Taelon venture creates a machine that allows people to vividly relive a memory, but Liam suspects a back alley version of the device is leading to the death of some users.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Once and Future World
programme.desc: Artifacts believed to be Taelon are found in South America. Renee and Liam try to beat Sandoval to the source to determine the importance of the found pieces.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Thicker than Blood
programme.desc: An old business partner of Augur's is hired by Da'an to get information about the Resistance, resulting in the death of many members. Meanwhile, Sandoval finds out he has a life threatening blood disorder.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: A Little Bit of Heaven
programme.desc: Liam and Renee investigate a dead pregnant woman missing her fetus. They discover a town that Da'an helped after a nuclear meltdown and a suspicious brother and sister who were part of an early experiment to combine human and Taelon DNA.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Pad'ar
programme.desc: Pad'ar is a fierce battle game where spectators can connect via a "jack patch" that Liam suspects is causing neurological damage to users. When a Pad'ar warrior dies, it raises even more questions about the safety.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: In Memory
programme.desc: Lili wakes up, supposedly on Earth after a coma, and is told the Jaridians have come and conquered the Taelons. She remembers Sandoval telling her she no longer has and Earth-based physiology and believes things are not as they seem.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Cloister
programme.desc: Zo'or and Da'an travel to a cloister for an energy sharing ceremony, but one of the sisters is killed and everyone is a suspect.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Interview
programme.desc: Zo'or agrees to do a live television interview to try to endear himself to humans, but the show's producer has an ulterior motive in getting him in front of a camera.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: The shuttle Liam and Zo'or are in crashes over wilderness, but survive in safety bubbles. The people they meet live off the earth and know nothing of the Taelons. However, Zo'or is injured and missing a Synod meeting on the mother ship.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Subterfuge
programme.desc: Sandoval has a mole attempting to gain information about Liam - particularly concerning his commitment to the Taelons. When a Taelon and protector are killed in a portal that malfunctions, Liam is suspicious that it was intentional.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Scorched Earth
programme.desc: Bombings begin at embassies and Liam believes they may reignite the SI (Sino-Indian) War, which ended with an armistice several years before. An old intelligence agency friend of Renee's has interesting holographic technology.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Liam Kincaid races against the clock to find Zo'or, who disappears after contracting an ancient Taelon virus that has the potential to cause a devastating plague.

programme.title: Hoarders

programme.title: The Raccoons

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: While staging a play, Cyril believes his theater is haunted. Strange events cause panic, but the truth behind the “ghost” reveals a more grounded explanation.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: The pigs hire a reporter to expose Cyril, while Bert reflects on past adventures. As secrets surface, Cyril’s reputation hangs in the balance amid growing tension.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril pursues a romance that quickly becomes complicated. Meanwhile, Bert and Cedric face fears during skydiving, learning to overcome anxiety in different ways.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril is hospitalized, leaving the pigs in charge of a major deal. Chaos ensues, while Bert tries to recover money from a bad purchase, leading to parallel struggles with responsibility.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Ralph’s family moves to Evergreen, bringing change and adjustment challenges. Meanwhile, the pigs take new jobs, leading to humorous clashes as everyone adapts to new roles.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril assigns Cedric to develop a new product, leading to unexpected discoveries. Meanwhile, a mysterious garbage train raises questions the gang must investigate.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bentley tries to repay a debt through a risky scheme that traps him and the pigs in caverns. Bert and others must rescue them, learning that shortcuts often lead to bigger problems.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bentley excels at work and earns a promotion, angering the pigs. Their sabotage backfires, and Cyril must fix the situation while recognizing Bentley’s true value.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert overcommits while preparing for a fair, trying to please everyone. Meanwhile, the pigs run another scheme. Both storylines show the cost of taking on too much.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bentley learns martial arts but faces challenges with discipline and trust. His mentor’s past complicates things, forcing Bentley to prove his dedication.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril launches a satellite service, while a mishap traps Broo inside it. A race against time ensues as the gang works to bring him back safely.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Lisa faces peer pressure, while Cyril tries to join an elite club. Both confront issues of identity and acceptance, learning to stay true to themselves.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert runs against Cyril for mayor, leading to a spirited campaign. Their clash highlights differing visions for the forest and tests their leadership.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: The pigs take on a risky side job involving toxic drums that end up in the forest’s water. The gang must act quickly to prevent environmental disaster.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: In the finale, Cyril retires and Cedric takes over, but a con artist manipulates him into a risky scheme. Bert and Lisa step in to help, leading to a final showdown about trust and responsibility.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert, Ralph, Melissa, and the gang secretly plan a surprise for Cyril Sneer. When Cyril notices odd behavior, he grows paranoid and believes the Raccoons are plotting against him, leading him to take drastic and ridiculous measures to defend himself.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert sets out to climb Evergreen Mountain alone to prove his independence. Meanwhile, Cyril Sneer plots to stop him to keep a hidden family secret safe. As Bert faces danger and doubt, he must rely on courage and determination to succeed.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Ralph take Cedric camping at their childhood fort, but to join their club, Cedric must spend the night in a haunted house alone. As fear sets in, Cedric discovers inner bravery while the others anxiously wait to see if he succeeds.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril and Mammoth Motors plan to build a factory that will harm the forest. To stop him, Bert and his friends create a solar-powered car to race against Cyril’s Sneermobile, with the future of Evergreen Forest depending on the outcome.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Feeling unappreciated, Cedric runs away and stays with the Raccoons. At the same time, Julie and Tommy run away but become lost in the forest. The gang must find them quickly while helping Cedric deal with his feelings about his father.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert, Cedric, and Broo discover a treasure map and begin searching the forest for hidden riches. When Cyril learns of their quest, he schemes to claim the treasure for himself, turning the search into a race filled with tricks and surprises.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Ralph and Cedric become trapped in Cyril Sneer’s new vault, which is filled with dangerous traps. Bert, Melissa, and Broo attempt a daring rescue, and even Cyril must help as they work together to escape before it is too late.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Ralph receives a job offer in the city, and Ranger Dan is given a similar chance. Bert worries the group will split apart and be unable to stop Cyril’s plans, forcing everyone to decide whether to follow opportunity or stay together.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: After telling too many wild stories, Bert is no longer believed when he discovers Cyril plans to pave the forest into a parking lot. With no one trusting him, Bert must find proof quickly before Cyril carries out his destructive plan.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: When Cedric and Sophia hear that royalty will visit Evergreen Forest, Bert dreams of becoming a knight. Meanwhile, Cyril wants knighthood for power, leading both into humorous efforts to impress the royal visitors during their stay.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril schemes to buy the Evergreen Standard by cutting off its supplies with help from Mr. Knox, who demands payment in gold. Bert tries to save the paper by finding a way to secure resources, leading to a risky plan to outsmart Cyril.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A pro baseball team visits Evergreen Forest and seeks a new player. Bert and Cedric both compete for the spot, straining their friendship as rivalry grows. In the end, they must decide what matters more, success or their bond.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril offers Bert a deal to become the face of his new cologne line. Tempted by fame and money, Bert considers the offer, but soon realizes the cost of endorsing Cyril’s schemes and must choose between integrity and success.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cyril panics when his betrayed partner Karl Snarl returns for revenge. Meanwhile, Bert discovers an old helicopter, and Melissa must overcome her fear of heights to help save her friends during a dangerous confrontation.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: After losing power due to unpaid bills, Cyril plans to build a dam to control energy in the forest. Meanwhile, Bert and Cedric stay with Aunt Gertie, whose strict ways test their patience while bigger trouble brews outside.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Cousin Bentley visits the Raccoons, bringing his usual quirks along. Meanwhile, Cyril seeks to regain his youth using a questionable potion, leading to chaos as his reckless attempt causes unexpected and humorous consequences.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Melissa explore echo caverns and discover strange cave art. Cyril, seeing profit potential, enters the art world and drives up prices. The gang must decide whether art is about value or meaning as greed takes over.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Believing Cyril is dying, Bert spends his savings on a tribute monument. When Cyril learns he is fine, he exploits the situation to sabotage the Evergreen Standard, forcing Bert to recover from his costly mistake quickly.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: Bert and Cedric meet a hermit living in a swamp rumored to hold oil. Cyril attempts to buy the land, threatening the hermit’s home. The gang must protect the swamp and prove its worth beyond the profit Cyril seeks.

programme.title: The Raccoons
programme.desc: A misunderstanding leads everyone to believe Cyril is marrying Lady Baden-Baden. Cedric questions his past while Mr. Knox hides his feelings for her. As confusion grows, truths come out and relationships are tested.

programme.title: Dora y sus amigos, en la ciudad

programme.title: Dora y sus amigos, en la ciudad

programme.title: Dora, la exploradora

programme.title: Dora, la exploradora

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Los Bubble Guppies visitan la Gran Ciudad Bubble para celebrar el Día del Camarón. Únete a ellos y descubre el alboroto de la gran ciudad y del Gran Edificio Bubble.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!

programme.sub-title: Diego and Alicia Save the Otters!

programme.title: Shimmer y Shine

programme.sub-title: Genie for a Day / Zac the Clueless Detective

programme.title: Dora y sus amigos, en la ciudad

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 109
programme.desc: Traci busca el amor a través de citas online pero no quiere abandonar la comodidad del hogar que enseña en cada cita. Rob gastará una broma con un video y el collar del falso perro parlante vuelve triunfante.

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 110
programme.desc: El equipo de "MTV Supershore" tenderán una trampa en un aestación de carga con un característica adicional: no sólo carga los móviles, también los roba! Traci toma la calle para investigar que clase de cosas vergonzosas tiene la gente en sus móviles.

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 111
programme.desc: En este capítulo de "Mtv Trolling" tendremos robots espeluznantes, desastrosos drones y un fotomatón muy bromista. Los presentadores Rob Anderson y Traci Stumpf te traen eso y más.

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 112
programme.desc: En este episodio de "Mtv Trolling" vamos a destrozar portátiles, robar contraseñas y hacer sonar alarmas. Los presentadores Rob Anderson y Traci Stumpf traen eso y más.

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 113
programme.desc: En este episodio de "Mtv Trolling" usaremos lasers para quemar la cara a la gente, golpearemos sus móviles con martillos y Rob nos llevará de novatadas.

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 114
programme.desc: En este episodio de Mtv Trolling tenemos taxistas asesinos, citasa ciegas muy curiosas, divertidos fotomatones y la novatada de Rob.

programme.title: MTV Trolling: Episodio 115
programme.desc: El mago y personalidad de YouTube, Rob Anderson, presenta este nuevo reality show internacional MTV Trolling. La serie de cámara oculta utiliza los dispositivos cotidianos para pillar a sus usuarios desprevenidos.

programme.title: 10 parejas 10: Episodio 101
programme.desc: Tras pasar una serie de tests de compatibilidad, diez chicas y diez chicos pasarán un mes juntos intentando encontrar su pareja perfecta.

programme.title: 10 parejas 10: Episodio 103

programme.desc: Brenda comienza el día con ganas de fiesta y confiesa su amor por uno de los Shore. La tensión sexual entre Chile y Anahí continúa. El viaje a Acapulco termina y, de regreso en México, Jey planea la celebración del cumpleaños a Dania.

programme.title: Acapulco Shore: Rusa de Cortesía
programme.desc: Nacha y Mane se enfrentan a Dania al ver que le tira sus cosas al agua. Los mariscos llegan para la cruda y la ida a un bar termina en una fiesta en la casa. Mane molesta a Dania y un nuevo enfrentamiento entre ellas comienza a gestarse.

programme.title: Red: Debieron decir la verdad

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura

programme.title: Los Dalton Contra Lucky Luke
programme.desc: Cuatro torpes hermano intentan impresionar a su criminal madre asaltando un banco.

programme.title: Past Sins
programme.desc: Donna, una prestigiosa abogada, debe defender el caso de una mujer cuyo ADN ha sido encontrado en un asesinato cometido hace 20 años.

programme.title: Instafama
programme.desc: Una fanática desquiciada de las redes sociales inculpa a su mejor amiga por asesinato.

programme.title: Breve encuentro

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Un mafioso recuerda su ascenso en el Londres de los años sesenta. La ambición y la envidia lo llevan a traicionar a su mentor, Freddie Mays, para convertirse en el gánster más temido de la ciudad.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Tras una temporada en Pekín, Roy y Jessie deciden viajar a Moscú en el Transiberiano, el ferrocarril que une la Rusia europea con las provincias rusas del Lejano Oriente.

programme.title: Antes de la revolución
programme.desc: A la edad de 22 años, Bertolucci dirige este drama político que relata la historia de un joven que se acerca al comunismo mientras mantiene una relación incestuosa con su tía.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: Una atractiva mujer visita España, donde mantiene un tórrido romance con un torero. Drama erótico a mayor gloria de Bo Derek, dirigida por su marido.

programme.title: El libro del amor
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su esposa, Henry se propone ayudar a un adolescente a construir una balsa.

programme.title: Sí quiero, pero no quiero
programme.desc: Lauren, una joven divorciada que trabaja organizando bodas, se enamora del novio de una de sus clientas.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: La señorita Julia
programme.desc: Una noche de verano en una mansión en el campo irlandés en 1880. La película explora la lucha de poder entre una joven aristócrata y el criado de su padre.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Tres historias de amor que se desarrollan en la misma ciudad. Paz y Jorge llevan tres años casados pero su matrimonio no funciona, la relación se está apagando y ninguno de los dos encuentra la solución.

programme.title: Will You Merry Me
programme.desc: After Rebecca and Henry get engaged, they gather their families for the holidays to surprise them with the good news. But will their clashing families ever get along?

programme.title: Bob Esponja
programme.desc: ¿Quién vive en la piña debajo del mar? ¡Bob Esponja! Sumérgete en Fondo de Bikini para vivir las aventuras más desternillantes con Bob Esponja, Patricio y Calamardo.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Bantling Boy
programme.desc: Un grupo de cuatro personas posee un caballo de carreras. Dos de ellos están desesperados por venderlo, los otros dos, decididos a quedárselo. Cuando uno de ellos es asesinado, Barnaby investiga el caso.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Sexto sentido
programme.desc: El inspector jefe Barnaby y el sargento Scott investigan la muerte de John Ransom en Midsomer Mere. Lo acababan de echar de un pub por pelearse, pero la autopsia muestra quemaduras en su calavera que indican que pudo ser electrocutado.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Secretos ocultos
programme.desc: Nick Turner, un abogado con problemas, cae del tejado de su casa. ¿Es un suicidio disfrazado de asesinato?

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: La ley es igual para todos
programme.desc: Cuando un gigante corporativo intenta adquirir una fábrica de salsa pequeña pero respetada y dirigida por una familia disfuncional, un cadáver desnudo aparece en el almacén.
programme.sub-title: La ley es igual para todos

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Rapsodia de Midsomer
programme.desc: Varias muertes suceden al descubrimiento de un antiguo manuscrito musical vendido barato en una subasta.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: La casa del bosque
programme.desc: Una casa vieja, oscura y aislada, encantada según los vecinos de Midsomer Newton, se convierte en escenario de un asesinato doble cuando una pareja de yupis buscando casa aparecen apaleados.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Papel mojado
programme.desc: Barnaby y Jones investigan una serie de asesinatos vinculados a la muerte de una reina de la belleza ocurrida hace varios años.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: El camino de la raposa
programme.desc: Sir Freddy Butler se desploma durante un discurso. La autopsia sugiere que murió por causas naturales, pero Barnaby no está convencido. Alguien roba el testamento de sir Freddy y quema la casa de su abogado.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Entre los muertos
programme.desc: Martin Barret, chantajista experto, es asesinado y no hay escasez de sospechosos.

programme.title: Los asesinatos de Midsomer: Cuatro funerales y una boda
programme.desc: Durante una excursión familiar con Joyce, su hija Cully y su madre que está de visita, el inspector jefe acaba investigando el asesinato de Mildred Danvers, cuya petaca de brandi fue saboteada con barbitúricos.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Semillas de destrucción
programme.desc: Botánica forense y geología: las plantas ayudan a proporcionar oxígeno y nutrientes para la existencia. El suelo es el abono de la vida. Sin embargo, ambos pueden dar pistas sobre la hora y el lugar de la muerte de una persona.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Dosis letal
programme.desc: Toxicología: las drogas pueden curar enfermedades y aliviar el dolor, pero también pueden ser agentes de asesinato.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Objetos mortales
programme.desc: Marcado de herramientas: una herramienta utilizada para cometer un delito a menudo puede ser la misma herramienta utilizada para resolverlo.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Sacados de la tumba
programme.desc: Nuevas técnicas forenses utilizadas para resolver casos antiguos: los avances en ciencia y tecnología alientan a detectives a revisar el pasado con la esperanza de responder preguntas que han quedado sin respuesta y resolver crímenes.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Testigos infalibles
programme.desc: Los investigadores siempre están en la vanguardia de las nuevas técnicas forenses que pueden ayudarlos a resolver los casos con mayor precisión.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Desde las cenizas
programme.desc: Investigación de incendios: antorchas de seguros, quemaduras de personas y asesinatos de incendios: estos crímenes están diseñados para destruir todas las pistas. Pero se puede construir un caso sólido a partir de un montón de cenizas.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Viviendo en terror
programme.desc: Terrorismo: Debido a la nueva tecnología y, quizás, al próximo milenio, el terrorismo es una amenaza internacional y creciente. La explosión de Oklahoma City y el bombardeo del World Trade Center son solamente dos de los incidentes de esta amenaza.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Obsesiones letales
programme.desc: Algunas personas no dejarán que nada se interponga entre ellos y sus metas. En sus mentes torturadas, el deseo crudo reemplaza toda razón, y el homicidio se usa como resolución conveniente.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Huellas delatoras de la culpa
programme.desc: A veces, las escalas de la justicia están equilibradas por unos pocos miligramos de evidencia: un par de fibras, un relleno dental o una mancha en un trozo de cinta. Los casos más grandes a menudo se resuelven con las pistas más pequeñas.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Testigo electrónico
programme.desc: El concepto de George Orwell de "gran hermano" permanece en el ámbito de la ficción. Pero a medida que la tecnología se hace a una parte mayor de nuestras vidas, es más difícil hacer un movimiento sin dejar un rastro electrónico.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Suposiciones incorrectas
programme.desc: Ocultar un cuerpo puede ser difícil; a veces, es más fácil ocultar o disfrazar las circunstancias de la muerte, convertir el asesinato en suicidio o culpar a otra persona. La verdad se dice a través de pistas sutiles tomadas de la escena del crimen.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Huellas imborrables
programme.desc: No importa cuan caótico o limpio que parezca la escena del crimen, el culpable siempre dejará algo detrás. De vez en cuando, es solamente una huella dactilar o una huella del zapato. A veces, eso es todo lo que se necesita.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Mujeres que matan
programme.desc: Los hombres no tienen el monopolio del asesinato, pero todavía es extraordinario cuando las mujeres matan. Aunque las asesinas son tan mortales como los hombres, eligen métodos menos violentos. A menudo son más astutos, calculadores.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Tratos mortales
programme.desc: Por un precio, todo es posible. Los asesinatos por contrato surgieron de la necesidad de establecer la coartada perfecta. Al contratar a alguien para hacer el trabajo sucio, una persona puede desviar la culpa.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Victimas en aumento
programme.desc: Algunas personas se salen con la suya, al menos por un tiempo. Llenos de su éxito, los asesinos en serie asesinan una y otra vez. Pero cada vez que matan, dejan algunas pistas más, y en última instancia llevan a su ruina.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Un gusto por el veneno
programme.desc: Los envenenadores son los asesinos más astutos, confiando en el sigilo o en la confianza de sus víctimas para matarlos. Son las criaturas más peligrosas del mundo: los asesinos inteligentes. Y por lo general no se satisfacen con una matanza.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives: Hallazgos en las tumbas
programme.desc: Algunos casos simplemente no se pueden resolver con la tecnología actual ni con la evidencia disponible. Pero eso no significa que se quedarán sin resolver para siempre.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Bosques oscuros
programme.desc: En junio de 1973, una niña fue secuestrada de un parque estatal en el río Missouri mientras acampaba con su familia. Varios meses pasaron sin tener una pista; luego, un agente del FBI tomó un interés particular en el caso.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Terror Doméstico
programme.desc: En 1996, un grupo de políticos extremistas robaron dos veces un banco en Spokane, Washington, con el uso de bombas caseras y la precisión militar para escapar.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Amistad fatal
programme.desc: En agosto de 1992, un hombre regresó a su casa en Memphis y descubrió que su esposa estaba desaparecida. El esposo, así como sus amigos, sus familiares y vecinos, empezaron a recibir llamadas al azar.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Pacto de muerte
programme.desc: En 1990 y 1991, la policía de Chicago y el FBI estaban tras el rastro de un ladrón de bancos cuyos asaltos se estaban tornando cada vez más violentos.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Confianza desecha
programme.desc: En 1988, surgieron nuevas pistas sobre la muerte misteriosa de un granjero de Carolina del Sur cuando un criminal confesó que dos miembros de la comunidad lo contrataron para cometer asesinato.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Empresa criminal
programme.desc: En octubre de 1993, un ladrón sorprendió a los clientes desprevenidos al descender por el techo de un banco de California. Cuando la policía llegó, escapó por el techo en medio de una balacera.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Cruce fatídico
programme.desc: En enero de 1984, un oficial de aduanas desaparece de su puesto cerca de Del Río, en el cruce de la frontera con Texas, incitando a la policía local a buscar a cuatro sospechosos latinoamericano. Al día siguiente, el oficial de aduanas fue hallado muerto.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Influencia mortal
programme.desc: Entre las guerras de cocaína en Miami a principios de 1980, tres cadáveres llevaron a un escuadrón táctico formado por varias agencias a sospechar que un grupo de policías podía estar involucrado en redadas ilegales por drogas.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Polly Klaas: Secuestrada
programme.desc: El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Por encima de la ley
programme.desc: El patrullero de carreteras de California, George Gwaltney, descubrió el cuerpo de Robin Bishop de 23 años cerca de su auto en una carretera remota en el desierto.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Presa Humana
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon asesinó a cinco amantes de la naturaleza al azar durante un periodo de tres años en el rural sur de Ohio. Después de una pista que guió al FBI al arma homicida, la prueba de balística arrojó una coincidencia.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Muerte en Alaska
programme.desc: En Anchorage, Alaska, una madre joven y sus dos hijas fueron violadas y brutalmente asesinadas. Solo había una pieza de evidencia forense: una toalla con ladillas que el asesino usó para limpiarse después del crimen.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Paraíso Mortal
programme.desc: Dos parejas se encontraron en la misma isla desierta y paradisíaca. Pero solo una pareja salió con vida. Buck Walker y Stephanie Stearns llegaron a Hawái en el Sea Wind, el cual le pertenecía a la pareja desaparecida, Mac y Muff Graham.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: La verdadera historia del Mississippi en llamas
programme.desc: El 21 de junio de 1964, tres defensores de los derechos civiles, uno blanco y uno negro, desaparecieron de Mississippi mientras cruzaban el condado de Neshoba.
programme.sub-title: La verdadera historia del Mississippi en llamas

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: El loco Don
programme.desc: Vagaba por las calles de la ciudad de Nueva York llevando solo piyamas y una bata de baño, pero el FBI estaba convencido de que Vince Gigante, el reputado jefe de la familia genovesa del crimen, no estaba loco.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: Rachas de asesinatos
programme.desc: Las violaciones y asesinatos de diez mujeres cerca de Tampa, Florida, en 1984, tenía desconcertadas a las autoridades y a la comunidad asustada.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI: El vaquero asesino
programme.desc: Claude Dallas vivía la vida de un vaquero. Un solitario y desconfiado de la autoridad, vivía de la tierra, practicando la caza furtiva y vendiendo las pieles.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Manuela se casa
programme.desc: Manuela se plantea si seguir adelante con la boda debido a los antecedentes delictivos de Carlos. Los niños, exceptuando los gemelos, hacen una colecta para comprar el regalo. Andrea se despide de la familia antes de marcharse a estudiar al extranjero.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Una duda insoportable
programme.desc: Ana no soporta la presión de no saber quién es el padre de su hijo. Fernando contrata como nueva cocinera a Catalina, una monja recién salida del convento de clausura, que se instala con su sobrina María. Don Nicolás pide matrimonio a Carmen.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Pasaporte a Viena
programme.desc: A pesar de las indicaciones de reposo del médico, Ana sale de casa para resolver un asunto muy urgente, y esto provoca que se resienta del esfuerzo realizado. Carmen y Silvia tienen billete para el primer vuelo a Viena y se despiden de la familia Hidalgo.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Por fin..., mamá
programme.desc: Ana da a luz a un niño al que llama Nicolás, en honor a su abuelo. Mientras, en la sala de espera, David y Fernando rivalizan entre sí para ver quién muestra mayor interés, lo que despierta las suspicacias y comentarios maliciosos de las enfermeras.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Al grano
programme.desc: Ana no le puede asegurar a David que es el padre de su bebé, cuya llegada a casa de los Hidalgo hace que Lucía se sienta desplazada. Nando por fin reúne el valor para confesar su secreto, no está matriculado en Derecho. Carolina y Sergio comen juntos.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: El resultado
programme.desc: Por fin se van a conocer los resultados de la prueba de ADN, pero David y Fernando prefieren llegar a un acuerdo antes de saber quién es el padre. Amalia gana una cena con el ídolo musical Jason Rodríguez; Carmen suele salir de casa misteriosamente…

programme.title: Ana y los 7: ¿El padre es?
programme.desc: A pesar de haberse comprometido a no hacerlo, David abre el sobre con los resultados de la prueba de ADN, y toma una importante decisión en consecuencia. Silvia y Fernando salen a cenar y pretenden prolongar la velada de manera íntima al volver a casa.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La espantada
programme.desc: El banco de Fernando experimenta cambios importantes y éste sospecha que David está detrás. Los gemelos suspenden once asignaturas entre los dos, y Lucía no termina a tiempo el mapamundi del colegio porque nadie le ayuda. Sharon invita a cenar a Alberto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Todo el mundo tiene un secreto
programme.desc: Ana vuelve a ejercer de niñera en la casa porque siente que los chicos están muy abandonados. Mak y Nando posan desnudos para un calendario. Ana recibe las flores de un admirador muy inesperado. Paula descubre que Carolina es la amante de su padre.
programme.sub-title: Todo el mundo tiene un secreto

programme.title: Ana y los 7
programme.desc: Los gemelos no consiguen que Alberto desista de darles clases particulares, pero el recibimiento que le hacen no será de su agrado ya que provocan un pequeño accidente. Carmen sigue preparando su boda con Don Nicolás y le pide a Ana que sea su madrina.
programme.sub-title: La boda de Carmen y Nicolás

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Vienen a por María
programme.desc: Los tíos de María solicitan su custodia al ir de visita y encontrársela con un aspecto poco adecuado; los niños harán todo lo posible para que se quede. Mientras Fernando, Don Nicolás y Ana visitan la tumba de Carmen, roban el coche con Nico dentro.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La fugitiva
programme.desc: La familia está triste por la marcha de María y ésta se siente muy sola con sus tíos, por lo que se escapa y vuelve a casa de los Hidalgo, donde acudirá a buscarla el inspector de menores. Catalina se siente culpable y piensa en irse de nuevo al convento.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Un muerto muy vivo
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, los gemelos golpean al asesor financiero de Fernando, y al creer que lo han matado, esconden su cuerpo. Fernando descubre que Nico es hijo suyo y no le perdona a Ana que se lo haya ocultado. La apendicitis de Lucía puede complicarse.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Rebelión a bordo
programme.desc: Los niños se escapan a casa de Sharon y no tienen ninguna intención de volver hasta que Fernando no cambie su actitud y readmita a Ana. El silencio de Lucía la está llevando a una posible peritonitis. Alberto pretende hacerse la vasectomía en secreto.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: De repente un extraño
programme.desc: Fernando intenta arreglar las cosas con Ana, pero ella le dice que busque nueva niñera. Llega a la casa Rafa, cuya personalidad es completamente opuesta a la de su hermano Bruno. Catalina se ofrece a acompañar a Sharon al casting de un musical.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: El secuestro
programme.desc: El hijo de un rico hacendado ha sido raptado y el padre recibe una petición de rescate firmada por Curro Jiménez, quien niega ser el autor del secuestro, también visita a la madre del niño, con quien mantuvo un romance y le promete ir a buscarlo.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: La Dolorosa
programme.desc: La Condesa de Palma va a un convento en busca de su sobrina Mercedes, pero se entera de que la joven se fue a la sierra con los bandoleros. Curro Jiménez planea con sus hombres dar un buen golpe.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: El destino de Antonio Navajo
programme.desc: Antonio Navajo, jefe de contrabandistas de determinada zona de la costa, hace un envío de géneros a Sevilla, a través de la sierra, territorio dominado por Curro Jiménez, que protegerá el transporte a cambio de una cierta cantidad de dinero.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: Carambola a tres bandas
programme.desc: Curro Jiménez, Pedro Higueras y Víctor Areco, jefes de tres partidas de bandoleros de la serranía andaluza, se entrevistan, a petición del segundo. La reunión se celebra en terreno neutral y cada uno acude con tres de su banda.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: Los rehenes
programme.desc: El usurero Anselmo García ha echado de su cortijo a la Condesa di Alloro, y se niega a darle dinero por sus joyas, por lo que la Condesa le ofrece a su hija para que se case con ella.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: La mujer de negro
programme.desc: Curro Jiménez recibe una carta comunicándole que un antiguo miembro de su banda se encuentra en grave peligro. Curro emprende el viaje recordando cómo conoció a su amigo y las luchas que sostuvieron contra los franceses.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: En la loca fortuna
programme.desc: El padre Javier atiende en confesión a un hombre a punto de morir.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: La muerte espera en Ronda
programme.desc: Los últimos ataques de los bandoleros a las diligencias que transportan viajeros franceses, hacen sospechar al ejército invasor que hay un espía entre las personas que las conducen. Los franceses tienden una trampa y caen en ella todos los implicados.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: Retorno al hogar
programme.desc: Curro Jiménez, nostálgico, decide ir a ver a su anciana madre. Allí se encuentra con una jóven que ayuda a la anciana, al parecer desinteresadamente. En realidad, se trata de una espía enviada allí por un enemigo del bandolero.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: El péndulo
programme.desc: Curro Jiménez y sus hombres asaltan una casa de juego. "El Estudiante", con el dinero robado, se refugia en una casa pobre, donde es atendido por el dueño, un anciano que vive con su hija enferma y el hijo de ésta.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: La leyenda de Zacarías Mendoza
programme.desc: Un personaje protegido por un alto cargo, se ve obligado a intentar la captura de Curro Jiménez. Para ello busca, coaccionando, la colaboración de Zacarías Mendoza, un antiguo bandolero retirado.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: El servidor de la justicia
programme.desc: Uno de los hombres de Curro Jiménez es asesinado en una fiesta gitana. El bandolero es apresado cuando va a notificar la muerte a los padres de su amigo, pero logra escapar y vengarse.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: La trampa
programme.desc: Los asaltos a diligencias son demasiado frecuentes y el capitán González pide más hombres para acabar con los bandoleros. Pero el Gobernador tiene un plan. Se entrevista con Curro Jiménez y pactan una tregua.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: En la boca del diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique y su hijo, al mando de unos hombres armados, se dedican a reclutar trabajadores para la recolección de productos, explotándoles míseramente y no pagando lo convenido. Curro Jiménez tendrá que intervenir.

programme.title: Curro Jiménez: Entierro en la serranía
programme.desc: Un jefe de policía llega a la comarca donde actúa Curro Jiménez. Tiene poderes absolutos para detener al famoso bandolero. La madre de Curro es detenida con intención de coaccionar al bandolero y que se entregue. La madre, enferma de gravedad, muere...

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Por lo general, es fácil determinar cómo un criminal entró en la escena del crimen. Pero en este caso, estaba lejos de esclarecerse. Parecía que el asesino se desvaneció y quizá lo hizo.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Fue uno de los casos más inusuales en la historia forense. Los investigadores tuvieron que encontrar una manera de resolver un caso de asesinato con una evidencia que consistía en un tomate aplastado encontrado en la escena del crimen.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Cuando una maestra dedicada y respetada desapareció, la policía tuvo que determinar si se había ido de vacaciones sin decírselo a nadie, o si era víctima de un juego sucio.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Después de que el sospechoso fuera declarado culpable de incendio premeditado y asesinato, mantuvo su inocencia pero fue sentenciado a 25 años de prisión.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: Una niña de seis años corrió y se escondió cuando vio que su abuela era golpeada hasta la muerte, pero el hombre la siguió, la golpeó y agredió. Ella dijo que el agresor era su tío, quien fue condenado. Se retractó de su testimonio años después.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
